title: service tunnel that leads to an outdoor compound?
content: my dream last night, I was trying to shop in a clothing store in the mall. I think it was a part I don’t go to very often because I didn’t recognize it. it was near completely empty. I found this book under the clothing racks, (it was just a travel guide to denmark?) and the employees immediately got super hostile with me. they were borderline scary, so I left and ended up in these incredibly dark service tunnels with green lights on the floors and tall rounded ceilings. a man actually tried to attack me right before I entered the tunnels. the hostility was unusual to me because the people in the mallworld aren’t usually mean or threatening, just kind of indifferent and silent? he grabbed me and threw me to the ground and threatened to pop my eyes out, trying to stick his thumbs in my sockets. I got away from him and made it outside, which was this area that was fully fenced in. it was a metal fence like the ones at a playground with concrete reinforcing it in certain parts. I got the vibe this was the “center” of the mall? It had these shacks that were lined in a few rows, and people, more like the shadows of people, black figures with no defining characteristics. they were running around like crazy, trying to jump the fence or scramble out of shack windows. super bizarre dream because mallworld isn’t usually like, scary or violent. I got the sense I was in a part I wasn’t supposed to be in and finding the book opened up the path to this area. just wondering if anyone’s seen something similar?
